components.name: Text Input

components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 240px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-adm-line, #e3e9e5); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-adm-card, #ffffff); color: var(--color-adm-ink, #111814); caret-color: #15803d; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #607066; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #15803d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #15803d; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item

components.html: Overview4Stations2
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 232px; padding: 12px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3e9e5; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: Geist, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #607066; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item span { flex: 1; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f3f6f4; color: #111814; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #15803d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #111814; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(17,24,20,0.12); } .ds-nav-active svg { color: #4ade80; } .ds-nav-chip { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #dcfce7; color: #15803d; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-nav-chip-active { background: #16a34a; color: #fff; }

components.description: Signature: a hairline carrying one notch per pending item, colored by kind. Closes into an unbroken emerald line when the queue is clear.
components.css: .ds-thread { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; width: 320px; height: 28px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-thread-line { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 2px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: #e3e9e5; } .ds-thread-notches { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; padding-right: 12px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-notch { width: 6px; height: 24px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-notch-danger { background: #dc2626; } .ds-notch-ok { background: #16a34a; } .ds-notch-pin { background: #84cc16; }

narrative.overview:
The admin is a well-lit desk: a soft sage canvas, crisp white sheets (cards, sidebar, header bar) separated by hairlines, charcoal ink for text, and leaf green for everything that is active or selected. One pale mint marks the single thing to press in a view. Nothing competes: no tinted sidebar, no gold, no heavy shadow.

The signature is the thread on the Overview: a hairline carrying one notch per pending item (flagged reports red, driver suggestions emerald, pin reviews lime). Clearing the queue closes the thread into an unbroken emerald line. Beside it sit the quiet data marks of the same family: slim emerald and lime bars, and a dotted-leader list of totals.

Density is operator-grade: plain, fast tables, 14px body with 13px table cells, 36px controls (44px on phones), tabular figures everywhere. Depth is tone and hairline first; shadows are whispers at rest and real only on floating layers. The world is light only (`color-scheme: light`, `data-theme="light"` forced by `AdminRoot`).
keyCharacteristics: Sage canvas, white surfaces, 1px green-grey hairlines.
Leaf green means active (selected tab, link, focus ring, default badge, toast); mint means "press me"; ink fills the active nav item.
One family (Geist) plus Geist Mono for ids and key figures; tabular numerals on by default.
Radius 6px on controls, 8px on nav items and dialogs, 12px on cards.
Emerald and lime are data colors (thread, bars, dots), not interface chrome.

rules.name: The Mint Rule
rules.body: Mint (#86efac) is the one pressable primary action in a view, always with ink text, never white. Leaf green carries selection and state; ink carries the active nav item. A mint element that cannot be acted on, or a mint button with white text, is a defect.

rules.name: The Prefix Rule
rules.body: Admin colors are `adm-` tokens only. Never reuse the driver app's tokens in admin screens, and never use `adm-` tokens outside admin and the kit.

rules.name: The Data Colors Rule
rules.body: Emerald and lime are for marks that show amounts and kinds (thread, bars, dots). Never set text in them, and never let a kind ride on color alone: every notch group has a count and a spoken label.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is weight and size, not new faces. 700 titles, 600 controls and labels, 400 prose; no other family enters the admin.

rules.name: The Whisper Rule
rules.body: At rest: no shadow on buttons, inputs, rows or tabs, and no more than a 1 to 3px, 12%-opacity shadow on cards and the active nav item. Anything bigger means the layer floats.

dos: Do use Mint Action (#86efac) with Ink text for the one primary action in a view, and New Tint (#fef9c3) for new or changed rows.
Do use Leaf Green (#15803d) for selection and state: the active tab rule, links, focus, default badge.
Do draw every divider as 1px Hairline (#e3e9e5).
Do build new admin screens from the kit in `src/components/ui` and the `adm-` tokens, in `AdminRoot`.
Do keep text AA on its ground: Ink or Mute Text on white or sage, white on Leaf Green, Ink on Mint.
Do keep tabular figures on counts and tables, and Geist Mono on ids and key totals.
Do reach for `adm-emerald`, `adm-lime` and `adm-foil-hover` rather than raw hex when adding data marks.
Do respect reduced motion (transitions collapse to 0.01ms under `prefers-reduced-motion`), keep touch targets at 44px under `md`, and keep form inputs at 16px there.
donts: Don't put white text on Mint Action, or use mint on anything that cannot be pressed.
Don't fill the active tab with mint; the active nav item is Ink, the active tab is a Leaf Green rule.
Don't set text in Lime, or in Mint on white. Neither passes AA.
Don't put shadows on buttons, inputs, rows or tabs; real shadows belong to dialog, drawer and toast.
Don't reintroduce the retired Security Print look: deep note-green sidebar, celadon page, foil gold (#c9a227).
Don't introduce another type family or dark mode in the admin.
Don't use driver-app tokens or styles inside admin screens.
Don't treat the legacy look of `AirtimePayouts.tsx` (behind an off feature flag) as part of this system.
